item.text:
Refactored another API-focused pass.

The main improvement is that weather and disease setup are more declarative now. [WeatherCond.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R011_module_java/WeatherCond.java:19) now exposes a direct `getAttribute(...)` lookup, so callers no longer need the raw weather-attributes map. In [Disease.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R011_module_java/Disease.java:38), disease configuration now uses fluent `affects(...)` and `startsWith(...)` methods instead of mutating internal maps from outside.

I also cleaned up simulator lifecycle/setup in [Simulator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R011_module_java/Simulator.java:88). View color registration moved into `configureViewColors()`, and startup/reset now share `initializeSimulation()`, so constructor/reset logic no longer repeats the same populate-and-render steps. The disease list construction there is shorter and easier to audit because it reads as data rather than a sequence of map writes.

Verification: `javac -Xlint:all *.java` passes cleanly. I did not run the Swing UI.
